title: Tactics Wars
tagline: A turn-based medieval strategy game on a grid, built alone as my bachelor's final project.
overview: A strategy game on a chessboard-like grid, where you gather resources, build, and organize an army to destroy your rival's urban center.
It is a complete game developed on my own, from planning to the enemy AI.

highlights.title: Grid-based tactics
highlights.text: Units move and buildings are placed on a custom grid.

highlights.title: Economy and army
highlights.text: Gather resources, construct buildings and train troops.

highlights.title: AI opponent
highlights.text: An enemy that makes strategic decisions on its own.

contributions: **Grid map system** for unit movement and building placement.
**Units and buildings**: stats and costs, balanced by me.
**Enemy AI** with Behaviour Trees and A* pathfinding.
learnings: Planning and scoping a whole project alone, and breaking it into tasks.
Building AI with behaviour trees and pathfinding.
Structuring a modular codebase with unit tests.
